title: EmbeddingGemma 2 brings multimodal search to local devices
friendlyTitle: A small Google model can search text, pictures, audio and video
summary: Google has released EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model that maps text, code, images, audio and video into a shared embedding space. Google says quantized versions can run on consumer devices with under 600MB of active memory for the full multimodal model.
friendlySummary: EmbeddingGemma 2 helps apps find related information across different kinds of files. It is small enough to run on some phones and computers.
whyItMatters: Developers can build private, offline search across mixed personal or business media without sending every file to a cloud service. The small footprint also makes local retrieval practical for mobile apps and coding tools, although Google’s benchmark claims still need testing on real workloads.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Apps may search private files locally instead of uploading them to the cloud. Developers should test its speed and accuracy on their own devices.
